title: Quadratic space bound for Word RAM decisions
statement: Let $P$ be an extended Word RAM program, $L$ a language of Boolean strings, and $S:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ a space-constructible function: $S(n)$ is at least $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$, and some finite Turing machine outputs the binary representation of $S(|x|)$ using at most $cS(|x|)$ space for some positive natural number $c$. Suppose that for every input $x$ there are a time bound $t$ and an output string $o$ such that $P$ halts within $t$ steps at word width $cS(|x|)$, outputs the membership indicator of $x$ in $L$, and touches at most $cS(|x|)$ addresses. Then $L$ belongs to space $S(n)^2$, that is, $L\in\mathrm{SPACE}(n\mapsto S(n)S(n))$.
hypotheses_covered: An extended Word RAM program $P$ and Boolean language $L$
Some positive natural number $c$ and finite Turing machine compute the binary representation of $S(|x|)$ using at most $cS(|x|)$ space
For every input, there are $t$ and $o$ witnessing a halting run at width $cS(|x|)$
The output is the membership indicator and at most $cS(|x|)$ addresses are touched
